verdict.rationale: The docs show users can choose between keeping codes only on the device ('Use without an account') or syncing them to their Google Account. That is a coarse local-versus-cloud storage choice, and manual QR export lets users keep physical copies on their own devices. Nothing shows any control over the region or residency of cloud-synced data. Missing for 10: region/data-residency selection for synced codes, documentation of where Google stores sync data, self-hosted or alternative sync backends.
